text:
McDonald’s up 40th Street food QUALITY took a dip / my thing is McDonald’s be FALSE ADVERTISING by having commercials with good juicy burgers fresh lettuce pickles onions tomatoes & freshest bread ever

When yo actually go in

Watch out below
Because that food doesn’t resemble the ad then I looked @ my cheeseburger patty & I said whoa is this even real/ so food industry I know 30 ye at s in it large batch cooking from SCRATCH/ good 2 the last drop
I don’t mind fast food but put it out like the commercial
Juicy burgers that make your mouth water not flat dead grey looking meat
Don’t let me get started on their steak egg & cheese

The steak was rubbery & it got put in the trash
Staff make sure your not burning them out having them looking crazy & not wanting to work & underpaying people

Amerikkka better change or they will lose in the end
author: Damon Grimes

text: Just came home from there. The employees are talking entirely too too much!! Yelling and being unprofessional! And on top of that got my order wrong. A sandwich short, and other things. The employees didn't pay attention. Instead of talking about nonsense focus on the job and the customers!!!! There needs to be a manager and employee firing and hire people that will boost your rating and be professional at all times. Attention!!!!! 3.0 is not a satisfactory rating, there is an internal problem and it shows. Just because it is located near a campus isn't a reason to skimp on professionalism and quality!!
author: Dominic Bright

text: This particular store is close to school. So, if feeling nostalgic and want to at least use the rewards points, I stop in. Dining area, never clean, neither Is the one bathroom out of two made available to customers. Addicts hanging in and around the lobby and front of store. Sub par, cold, flavorless food. Doesn't matter if you use the app or not, terrible service, with a dirty nasty, lobby, with staff who could care less! Visited a McDonald's in Port Richmond, the best experience ever!!
author: Andrea Lacey

text: I walk in there and place an order for 2 big macs and large fries. (Every time I go in a McDonald's it's always young people on their phone) It was nobody in there accept people sitting and a homeless guy. I see them making the 2 big Macs and fries bag them up and give it to a homeless person. So I'm still waiting and more people come in order get their food and leave. I'm like where's my order. They're standing their looking dumb. So they knew what I ordered then made it. Never again.
author: Nathaniel Baker

text: Food is made fast. The employees have a really nasty attitude right up to the moment you walk in and then when you get your order. But it’s the city and we right by the bottom in West Philly. Should’ve never expect any type of respect from the hood chicks working a minimum wage job that they’re obviously depressed in. Hope they do mature and better in life.
author: Kingston Ou

text: Don’t go to this McDonalds!!! Food was dry and tasted awful. Restaurant was very smoking(burning oil or something) from the kitchen. Soda is disgusting, I don’t know if the carbonation pressure is off or the syrup is expired. Cashier was awesome and very helpful.   Most be a short line to get the job as the manager of this McDonald’s, and it shows.
author: Kevin Linahan

text:
The night shift cashier had a bad attitude and was rude to mostly everyone ordering. I get it's only McDonald's, but this has to be one of the worst customer service experiences ever.

Even if I was starving, I wouldn't come here again. Took too long to get an order of fries and nuggets while many other orders after mine were fulfilled.
author: Kat A.

text:
I went there before 11PM, and this is what I saw.
I guess even the dine-in is available, but they just dont want people to do so.

Add-on: Ordered a large smoothie, and at the end, they said they ran out of large bottle, so they directly changed to medium without any refund or subtitles. I don't even know if I should say 'thank you'...
author: g 了个大G

text: The sign on the door says the inside restaurant is open 24 hours. That's a lie though. They kicked me out at 4am while i was in the middle of eating a burger. "We're closed". I'm not even mad, just update the sign man. You wanna be an "open 20 hours" establishment and be closed from 2am-6am cool just say so.
author: Matthew Gavin

text: Homeless people use this location as their hotspot so atmosphere is not pleasant, on this occasion on 12/30/25 at 8:11 they served me two pancake platters without syrup. Laughable incompetence on the staffs part. Is it so hard to put syrup in the bag?? You put butter but no syrup ??? Abysmal service
author: Jean Adou

text: Not 24 hours. You have to use their shitty app to order during off hours because they lock the doors. Thank you for reminding me that I live in a technohellscape where even the hungry can't order a god damn sandwich without a phone glued to their hands. I'd rather starve, thanks. 👎
author: Alicia Porter

text: Workers are lethargic, walk around like zombies. I ordered 1 frozen coke 15 minutes before arrival got there and waited for 15 more minutes, still nothing, I then had to ask twice before they gave me my frozen coke. 30 minutes for a frozen coke is ridiculous and it wasn't even busy.
author: nivedha saravanan

text: The food of McDonald’s is the same great taste, but when I went to the bathroom it was dirty, filthy, no soap, no toilet paper, and there was pee on the floor. Over all I guess it was fine but more cleaning is needed.   I have to add one more thing the fries are salty, the worst.
author: ItzLyra21 •

text: Ordered 3 drinks....... took almost 20 minutes to get it right. In the end I almost felt bad for the employees.  Truly seemed like there was only one competent employee, but one person can not run an entire restaurant. Praying sis gets the help (coworkers) she needs.
author: Kaci Kellum

text: Says dining room open 24 hours but we got there and even though there was staff, the doors were locked. Someone mopping pointed people to the pick up window but no one was there. There was a Door Dasher that cancelled the order cuz no one would come to the window.
author: Countess

text: The slowest restaurant I’ve ever been to! You need to hire more workers for night time, train them again and teach them how to move and cook faster. This is ridiculous. I shouldn’t have to wait 15-45min for my food. Fix it
author: Hannah K Elliott

text: perhaps the worst mcdonalds ive ever been to. i mobile ordered an ice cream and they didnt make it for half an hour. asked the staff multiple times to make me but they didn’t do it and worked on other orders.
author: a bk

text: Some mornings you stand at the counter waiting to be helped while staff talk in the back…I mobile ordered a sausage burrito which was ice cold and unappetizing. Never a good experience here…won’t be back!!
author: Danyelle Jackson

text: Don't come here. The drive-thru area says any side at any time, but they only serve one side,We waited for hours and they never served us, this is the worst place to order.
author: Yuni

text: The attitude from the staff is unbelievable unprofessional, especially from the store manager. Worst McDonald’s I’ve ever experienced.
author: Joshuel Velez
